thread:
anya: quick heads-up — noticed token-perf drop in int4 bringup after ~200k tokens. kv-cache hit rate falls and latency spikes. repro logs: https://ci.redwood/infruns/3721 :thinking_face:

michael: hmm, seen similar with rot-phase adjustments. what model/config?

anya: bringing up rdl-7b-int4 (quantized via q4f, compiled with v2 kernels). warmup sequence uses stride=1024, window=32768. initial perf good, then throughput drops ~30% and token divergence appears in long prompts.

raj: could be prefix eviction frequency + stride misaligning KV indices. any evidence of rotation/wrap?

anya: logs show repeated KV writes at indices that overlap previous ranges. snippet:
```
[INFO] kv_write: shard=2 idx_start=31488 len=4096
[INFO] kv_write: shard=2 idx_start=32784 len=4096 <-- overlaps previous by 700
```

katie: overlap by non-power-of-two amounts smells like stride vs tiling mismatch. What's stride in the runtime config?

anya: runtime config used:
```
warmup_stride=1024
kv_tile_size=4096
prefill_policy=serial
```

sam: if kv_tile_size isn't aligned with stride*prefetch_count, we can get fragmentation. Also RoPE scaling interacts when indices wrap near window bound.

olivia: can you run a short reproducer with `--seed=42 --limit-tokens=250000 --log-kv=true` and attach trace? I'll run a quick pass on a dedicated instance.

anya: starting run now, link: https://ci.redwood/infruns/3722. tagging @olivia @sam @raj. thanks :pray: 

ci-bot: job 3722 started on dedicated-gpu-8 (runnable)

olivia: quick update — I see KV write coalescing disabled in this build (missed flag). enabling `kv_coalesce=true` eliminated overlaps in my local run. latency stabilizes. still need to confirm no quality regressions.

michael: good find. can we add a unit test for misaligned stride/tile config? even a fuzz test for random strides (256..2048) and tile sizes (1024..8192) would catch this.

anya: agreed. I'll open a PR with a small fuzz harness and add a repro script. plan: default `kv_coalesce` to true in next patch and gate on int4 bringup. PR in ~1h.

katie: sounds good. also add an assertion to reject configs where `kv_tile_size % stride != 0` unless `kv_coalesce` is true.

raj: we should also audit RoPE wrap handling near window boundary. adding this to long-context regression suite.

anya: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/891 — includes fuzz harness, repro cmd, and config assertion. cc @michael @katie

sam: will review. :thumbsup: 

olivia: leaving notes in the CI run about quality checks. will run evals against goldset.

anya: thanks everyone — keeping the thread here. will post postmortem if we hit regression after default change.
